title: Matchings in hypergraphs via Ore-degree conditions
summary: Let $\mathcal{H} \subseteq \binom{[n]}{r}$ be an $r$-uniform hypergraph on vertex set $[n] = \{1,2,\dots, n\}$. For an $r$-set of vertices $S \subseteq [n]$, the \emph{degree} of $S$ is defined as $\textrm{deg}(S)=\sum_{v \in S}\textrm{deg}(v)$ and the minimum of $\textrm{deg}(S)$ over all non-edge $r$-subsets $S \not \in E(\mathcal{H})$ of $V({\cal H})$ is the {\it Ore-degree} of ${\cal H}$, denoted by ${σ_r}({\cal H})$.
